title: Streaming private banks for polynomial-source DCP

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the streaming private-bank algorithm specified in proof.md with BASE13 in base13.md has total sequential work O(2^(n/6) n^5 (log2 n)^(3/2)), exact growth index 1, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the streaming private-bank algorithm specified in proof.md with BASE13 in base13.md has peak classical bits O(n^3), exact growth index 0, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the streaming private-bank algorithm specified in proof.md with BASE13 in base13.md has peak allocated qubits O(n^2), exact growth index 0, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the streaming private-bank algorithm specified in proof.md with BASE13 in base13.md has all source acquisitions O(n^5), exact growth index 0, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and s, the same streaming private-bank algorithm recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 7/8 jointly with the other bounds when epsilon(n)=L/(549755813888*n^4), L=log2 n and n=ceil(log2 N). Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. The set and joint state are fixed before the algorithm's private coins.
